Writes blog posts optimized for search engines and humans

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of SEO Writer skill.

- Generates SEO-optimized blog posts for Google and human readers without keyword stuffing.
- Collects detailed user inputs: target/secondary keywords, search intent, audience, word count, and tone.
- Follows a structured framework covering title, meta description, URL, content flow, keyword placement, and linking.
- Ensures high readability with clear formatting, short paragraphs, and image suggestions.
- Includes snippet optimization and provides outputs in markdown format with all SEO elements.
